notes.cookieEncryption: Blueprint 6.6 resolves the conflict in favour of the packaging owner and 11 section 6.1: left disabled in V2. No cookie exists because the session is in memory. Enabling it is a one way transition, so a later round changes it deliberately.
notes.wasmTrapHandlers: Untouched, left enabled. Not a security switch: disabling it trades memory safety for speed.
notes.loadBrowserProcessSpecificV8Snapshot: On, and the release build must produce the browser process snapshot. If the build does not, the fuse write fails and that is the correct outcome, not a reason to flip it off.
notes.embeddedAsarIntegrityValidation: macOS as of Electron 16.0.0, Windows as of Electron 30.0.0. Absent on Linux, residual row 19.
